Loss report: gitlab -> drone
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/images/step/script step.shell (Drone compiles commands into its own set -e script that runs under /bin/sh; a step with no shell from a GHA or GitLab source runs under bash there, so bash-only syntax fails when the image sh is dash)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/package ext.passthrough (Ext of provider gitlab (needs_extra) is not written to the Drone file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/package-all ext.passthrough (Ext of provider gitlab (needs_extra) is not written to the Drone file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/package-all/step/script step.shell (Drone compiles commands into its own set -e script that runs under /bin/sh; a step with no shell from a GHA or GitLab source runs under bash there, so bash-only syntax fails when the image sh is dash)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/package/step/script step.shell (Drone compiles commands into its own set -e script that runs under /bin/sh; a step with no shell from a GHA or GitLab source runs under bash there, so bash-only syntax fails when the image sh is dash)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/images job.container: default image ubuntu:latest (the job names no image, so steps without one run in ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/images job.matrix: one pipeline document per cell (fail-fast and max-parallel are lost; a failed sibling stops the others without order)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/package job.container: default image ubuntu:latest (the job names no image, so steps without one run in ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/package-all job.container: default image ubuntu:latest (the job names no image, so steps without one run in ubuntu:latest)
